notes: Electron runtime updated to v44.9.2 — maintenance update with Electron fixes, including blocking the compromised eMudhra certificate authority keys
Fixed: Seasonal themes now show only in their season in both theme pickers, and Hanami and Velvet Rose have seasons.
Updated: minimum certifi and websockets versions, so new installs start with the latest certificate list and connection library
Electron runtime updated to v44.9.0 — maintenance update with Electron fixes
Electron runtime updated to v44.8.0 — Chromium 152.0.7977.167 and backported Chromium and V8 fixes
Electron runtime updated to v44.8.0 — fixes the mouse cursor going missing over native dialogs in certain cases
Electron runtime updated to v44.7.2 — backported ANGLE, Chromium, PDFium and V8 fixes

Changed: Electron now updates by itself after an app update. The new version is downloaded first and only replaces the current one once it is ready, so a failed or offline download no longer leaves the app without Electron.
Changed: The portable edition now checks the file it uses to set up pip with a pinned checksum on first run, like it already does for Python and Node.js.
Electron runtime updated to v44.7.1 — Linux crash fixes (no display server, menu bar, folders with non-ASCII names), a renderer crash fix and updated Chromium
Fixed: The startup cleanup of leftover partial files now only removes files the app created, and a download folder from an imported settings file is checked before it is used.
